summary: The change moves the existing selectionchange wait into a shared `clickEditorText` helper in the Electron E2E file. The block-selection test and both clicks in the list-movement test now use it. The old anchor poll is replaced by a focus assertion on the editor. I checked `useMarkdownEditor.ts:101-103`: the aria-label is placed on the contenteditable element, so `editor.and('[contenteditable="true"]')` matches the right element. The durable run passes, no executable source lines changed, and I found nothing that blocks merging.
